description: Submit an order request on behalf of the buyer, after they approved the items and the quote total. No payment is taken and nothing is charged: a 6-digit code is emailed to the buyer; after the buyer confirms (confirm_order or the email link) a manager checks it and contacts them. idempotency_key is required: reuse it on retries so a lost reply never creates a second request. Keep order_secret from the reply for confirm_order. Use only the buyer's own email with their consent. Limits: 3 requests per hour per buyer email and per network address.

email.description: The buyer's own email: the confirmation code is sent there

delivery.description: Ukraine: city and Nova Poshta branch. EU: street address and city. Or other delivery wishes

expected_total_minor.description: total_minor from the quote the buyer agreed to

idempotency_key.description: Required. A new UUID v4 per order request; on a retry (timeout, lost reply) send the SAME key: you get the same order and its order_secret instead of a duplicate

lang.description: Site language and market: uk (Ukrainian, default) and ru (Russian) = Ukraine, prices in UAH, Nova Poshta delivery; en (English, site root) = EU market, prices in EUR, delivery to EU countries (ship_to is required for quote and place_order).

ship_to.description: Delivery destination. Required when lang is en (EU market: shipping and VAT depend on the country); must be omitted for uk and ru (Ukraine: Nova Poshta).

country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (DE, PL, FR…)

name: place_order
title: Submit an order request
